info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Retail Orders Cancel-v5-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Cancellation API allows businesses to manage order cancellations efficiently. This endpoint enables users to cancel specific retail orders by providing the order details. Retail teams and customer service representatives commonly utilize this functionality to address customer requests for order changes. By integrating this API, businesses can streamline their order management processes and enhance customer satisfaction.

delete.description: This API endpoint allows users to cancel a previously placed order. It will remove the order from the system if it is eligible for cancellation, ensuring that users have the ability to manage their orders effectively.

requestBody.description: Request body for canceling an order. This payload should contain the necessary information to identify the order that needs to be canceled.

204.description: Cancellation request processed successfully with no content returned.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for canceling an order operation through a DELETE request.

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the order cancellation.

resultId.description: The unique ID of the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the order after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

message.description: Optional message providing additional information about the cancellation.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelResponse_204.description: Response schema for cancelling an order operation.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the cancellation audit entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the cancellation was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information for the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This value provides insight into the performance of the server when handling the cancellation operation.
